source:
@@U01378@@
I feel you're only sparing me, sir;
that you're being considerate
so as not to embarrass me.
Travelers are very good in that way;
they make the best of it just out of kindness.
I know that my poor chatter
could never amuse a man of your experience.

@@U01380@@
One look, one word from you means more to me
than all the wisdom of the world.

@@U01381@@
(He kisses her hand.)

@@U01383@@
Oh, you mustn't put yourself out!
No!
How could you even want to kiss it?
A hand so rough and ugly!
When I think of all the work it’s done!
My mother’s much too particular.

@@U01384@@
(They walk on.)

@@U01386@@
And you, sir, are you always on the go?

@@U01388@@
Yes, business, duty!
Hard taskmasters, you know.
It’s with no great pleasure we leave certain places.
And yet, there’s no other way.

@@U01390@@
It’s all very well when you're young and eager
to wander the world and take it for all it’s worth;
but let the sour years come,
and what choice is there but to drag on to the grave,
translation:
@@U01378@@
我觉得你只是在饶恕我，先生；
你很体贴
以免让我难堪。
旅行者在这方面非常好；
他们只是出于善意而充分利用它。
我知道我可怜的喋喋不休
永远不会让像你这样有经验的人感到高兴。

@@U01380@@
你的一个眼神、一句话对我来说意义重大
胜过世间一切智慧。

@@U01381@@
（他亲吻她的手。）

@@U01383@@
哦，你可不能把自己丢出去！
不！
你怎么可能想亲吻它？
手又粗又丑！
当我想到所有的工作都完成了！
我妈妈太挑剔了。

@@U01384@@
（他们继续走。）

@@U01386@@
那么，先生，您总是在忙碌吗？

@@U01388@@
是的，生意，职责！
严酷的监工，你知道的。
我们离开某些地方并不愉快。
然而，没有其他办法。

@@U01390@@
当你年轻且渴望的时候一切都很好
环游世界并充分利用它的价值；
但让酸涩的岁月到来，
除了拖进坟墓之外，还有什么选择，
